notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI mirrors the ask-once GameObject template cache faithfully: RequireGameObjectTemplate dedupes per entry with a pending set, ApplyGameObjectQuery decodes the 5875 response (high-bit miss cached), and the LockId property reproduces Benilla's exact type->data[] slot map (DOOR/BUTTON slot 1, CHEST family slot 0, FISHINGHOLE slot 4). Lock.dbc is loaded and drives the use-vs-cast routing: UseGameObject casts a known OPEN_LOCK spell (effect 33 matched against the lock's skill lock-types) or sends CMSG_GAMEOBJ_USE, with the mailbox local-open exception. Tracked-resource matching (PLAYER_TRACK_RESOURCES vs lock type) is live for gathering nodes. The consumers Benilla feeds beyond that are absent.
